title: Stalks of O_X-modules commute with kernels, images and cokernels (Stacks 01AG)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] (more generally a ringed space $(X,\mathcal O_X)$), $\textit{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ the abelian category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (kernels computed sectionwise, cokernels the sheafifications of the sectionwise cokernels), $x\in X$, and stalks, germs and stalk maps $\varphi_x$ as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Let $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be a morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with kernel $k:\operatorname{Ker}\varphi\to\mathcal F$, cokernel $c:\mathcal G\to\operatorname{Coker}\varphi$, and image $\operatorname{Im}\varphi=\operatorname{Ker}(c)\subseteq\mathcal G$ with inclusion $\iota$ and the factorization $\varphi=\iota\circ\bar\varphi$, $\bar\varphi:\mathcal F\to\operatorname{Im}\varphi$. Then: (1) if $\varphi_U$ is injective for every open $U$ (e.g. $\varphi$ a monomorphism, or the inclusion of a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module), $\varphi_x$ is injective; (2) $k_x$ is injective with image $\operatorname{Ker}(\varphi_x)$; (3) $c_x$ is surjective with kernel $\varphi_x(\mathcal F_x)$, so it induces an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules $\mathcal G_x/\varphi_x(\mathcal F_x)\cong(\operatorname{Coker}\varphi)_x$; (4) $\bar\varphi_x$ is surjective and $\iota_x$ is injective with image $\varphi_x(\mathcal F_x)$, i.e. $(\operatorname{Im}\varphi)_x=\operatorname{Im}(\varphi_x)$ as submodules of $\mathcal G_x$; (5) a complex $\mathcal F\to\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is exact at $\mathcal G$ if and only if $\mathcal F_x\to\mathcal G_x\to\mathcal H_x$ is exact at $\mathcal G_x$ for every $x\in X$.

source.place: Modules, Section 17.3 (lines 102-146: Ker(phi)_x = Ker(phi_x), Coker(phi)_x = Coker(phi_x) since stalks commute with sheafification) and Lemma 01AG (label lemma-abelian, line 149)
